text: A simplicial fibration (Kan fibration) p: E → B has the property that:
choices: p has the right lifting property w.r.t. all horn inclusions Λⁿₖ ↪ Δ[n]
p has the right lifting property w.r.t. all boundary inclusions
explanation: Kan fibration: p has the RLP w.r.t. all horns (all k); trivial Kan fibrations have the RLP w.r.t. all boundaries.
